title.value: Qualitative Code Suggestion: A Human-Centric Approach To Qualitative Coding
title.justification: The paper presents the development and evaluation of a new task in qualitative coding, named Qualitative Code Suggestion (QCS). It represents a shift towards a more human-centered approach to assist qualitative researchers, making the title apt and representative of the core content of the paper.
title.quote: In this work, we take a more assistive approach by defining the task of qualitative code suggestion (QCS) in which a ranked list of previously assigned qualitative codes is suggested from an identified passage.

extractions.description: This paper introduces and investigates a new task called Qualitative Code Suggestion (QCS), which aims to assist qualitative researchers by suggesting codes based on previously coded text passages. The research focuses on understanding challenges in coding processes and proposes methods like using NLP to improve efficiency in qualitative coding. It presents a dataset related to cardiovascular disease interviews and evaluates the AI systems via human-centric metrics.
